headline: Exchange Dollar Outflow Widens To 261.6 Million Dollars From 172.5 Million
narrative: Exchanges recorded a 261.6 million dollar net outflow over 24 hours, wider than the 172.5 million dollar outflow on the prior print. Bitfinex led that outflow at 97.1 million dollars, with Binance at 62.1 million and OKX at 59.3 million. The figure measures custodied dollar value across venues, and a negative print means more value left trading venues than entered, a mild accumulation reading on that pipe.
author: jordan
